PLAN into Monday 8/10, structure-first: HOLD the structural SPY/SPMO core (the multi-month bull-stack is intact at a fresh high). On the measured index / broad-momentum beta add, two of the three re-add conditions are met — breadth cleared 60% on the 8/7 close (61.77%) and dealers are in POSITIVE gamma with the model spot above the 769.91 flip — so the amplification objection is gone, but the leader reclaim is still missing: SPMO is a hair below its 50-day (~150.65). Keep the beta add STOOD DOWN and re-stage it only on a completed close that keeps breadth above 60%, holds SPY above the 769.91 flip in positive gamma AND reclaims SPMO above ~150.65, sized on the x1.03 throttle. HOLD MSFT and do NOT chase the extended, still-tangled gap. On the hedge: with dealers in positive gamma (they dampen/pin), the July NFP binary resolved benignly and atmIV crushed to 7.23%, the acute event and amplification risks that justified insurance are both gone — RUN THE SMALL RESIDUAL DOWN toward zero into Monday, retiring the last of it on a completed close that reclaims the 775 call wall with VIX holding under ~15.00. Persistence by distinct COMPLETED daily bars (intraday and weekend refresh runs not counted): the de-risk theme ran ~15 (7/09->7/29); the risk-on reversal ran 5 completed up bars (7/29, 7/30, 7/31, 8/3, 8/4); the failed-breakout stall was 2 completed bars (8/5, 8/6); and the broad-participation leg above 60% printed 1 bar (8/4), failed on 2 (8/5, 8/6 at 43.75%), and RE-BROADENED on the completed 8/7 bar (61.77%) — still 1 completed bar of renewed breadth, not yet a persistent leg. Overnight/weekend risk: a Monday-open gap fade that drives SPY back below the 769.91 flip into the 770 put wall would flip dealers to amplifying; the still-unverified official July NFP figure and 7/29 Fed statement/path remain re-pull items. Catalysts, nearest-first: whether Monday's 8/10 CLOSE confirms the re-broadening (breadth holding above 60%, SPMO reclaiming its 50-day, SPY holding above the 769.91 flip toward the 775 call wall) versus a fade below the flip into the 770 put wall; the direction of conditional vol (regime still elevated even as VIX sits at a calm 14.9 and atmIV has crushed to 7.23%); the official July NFP figure (react tape-inferred benign, re-pull the actual print); the still-unverified official 7/29 FOMC statement/path (re-pull); and the BLS preliminary benchmark revision 8/28.
